verdict.line: You lose if you trade into Volibear's empowered W before level 6; you win every all-in once Realm of Death is up.

brief.thesis: This is a dead-even matchup at 50.9% over 2280 games because both champions are weak pre-6 skirmishers who become terrifying duelists at level 6. Volibear's Frenzied Maul (W) punishes short trades with a heal, so Mordekaiser's job before level 6 is to deny CS and avoid stacking that mark, then flip the lane the moment Realm of Death comes online.

theirWindow.when: W mark applied and he closes distance
theirWindow.what: He is about to recast W for bonus damage and a heal. Back off or interrupt with your own trade; do not stand still and let him land the second cast.

yourWindow.when: Level 6 hits and R is off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Realm of Death pulls Volibear into an isolated duel where you steal a slice of his stats. Force the fight here, not before — your kit has nothing to punish his Q (Thundering Smash) gap-close pre-6.

powerCurve.note: Q stun into empowered autos wins short trades
Realm of Death turns duels your way
Full build sustain outlasts his burst

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Taken in 71.2% of games (49.9% WR, 2010 games) — the sustain and mana from two potions lets you hold W (Indestructible) stacking uptime through his poke without needing to recall early.

boots.why: 50.2% pick rate at 49.5% WR — the magic resist and tenacity shortens how long Thundering Smash's stun locks you into his empowered autos.

core.why: First item in the top three build paths (9.8%, 6%, 4.8% pick) — the slow on Obliterate (Q) and Death's Grasp (E) keeps Volibear inside your damage aura instead of letting him kite with Attack Speed stacks from his passive.
Second item in every major build path — omnivamp sustains you through extended trades while Volibear's W heal tries to outlast you.
Most common third item (9.8% path, 61.6% WR) — burn damage punishes him for standing in melee range to land his on-hit W stacks.

situational.when: he is building into sustained heal-reliant trades or ahead in damage
he rushes attack speed items to abuse his passive's bonus magic damage proc
you need an early anti-heal/armor spike before full Riftmaker completes

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in the top two rune pages (47.6% and 11% pick) — stacking Conqueror through extended Obliterate/Death's Grasp trades out-damages Volibear's short burst-and-heal pattern over a full fight.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 81.7% of games at 50.5% WR — Ignite denies the sustain from his W heal on kill attempts, which matters since he can refund HP by double-tapping Frenzied Maul.

playing.title: Hold W stacks, don't waste them
playing.detail: Indestructible (W, cooldown 12/11/10/9/8s) stores damage dealt and taken into a shield you consume for healing. Bank it through his Q stun rather than popping it reactively on cooldown.

playing.title: Never trade into a fresh W mark
playing.detail: If you see Frenzied Maul's mark on you, Volibear is one recast from bonus damage and a heal. Disengage or burst him down before he lands the second hit.

playing.title: Save Death's Grasp for his Q cooldown
playing.detail: E (cooldown 16/14/12/10/8s) pulls him into your damage aura. Using it while his Thundering Smash (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cooldown) is down removes his only gap-close/stun, making the pull safe.

playing.title: Don't contest before level 6
playing.detail: You have no stun, slow, or burst to answer his empowered autos pre-Realm of Death. Farm under tower pressure instead of matching his trades levels 1-5.

playing.title: All-in the instant R is up
playing.detail: Realm of Death (cooldown 140/120/100/90/80s) isolates him and steals stats — this is your one clean kill window per level-up. Initiate it, don't wait for him to engage first.

playing.title: Track his Sky Splitter cooldown
playing.detail: E (16s cooldown, 1200 range) slows and shields him if he's in the blast. If he's just used it for wave clear or poke, it's a 16-second window where he has no ranged tool to punish your approach.

playing.title: Respect Stormbringer near your tower
playing.detail: His ultimate (cooldown 160/135/110/110/110s) disables towers near its landing zone. Don't overextend under tower once he's level 16+ and R is live — a bad teleport engage there can snowball into a tower loss.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning connecting them to ability mechanics and timing windows is this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting Volibear before reaching level 6. Use your skills to focus on farming and contesting lane.
